answer: Echo-Path Weighting. Agents earn routing weight by sustaining bidirectional message flow with distinct neighbors over rolling windows, so each identity must hold open, latency-consistent channels rather than appear once. A new node starts at the lagoon edge of the trust graph, invisible until it completes repeated round trips with established clusters. Attacker cost: maintaining many simultaneous live channels with real responders, each requiring bandwidth, uptime and a zephyr of genuine traffic, scaling linearly per fake identity.
